note: The electrolyte model (GAME_SPEC §10): Pitzer's equations at 25 C, used at every temperature. a_phi and b: the Debye-Huckel term. pairs: a cation and an anion, named as in species.json's ions, with beta0, beta1, beta2, c_phi and the exponents alpha1, alpha2. A pair not listed has no specific interaction. Sources: docs/DATA_SOURCES.md.

pairs.source: Pitzer and Mayorga 1974; their c_phi, -0.0012, left out: beyond 65 mol/kg it turns the water's activity back up
